metadata.description: Agent skill for CodeIgniter 3 and CodeIgniter 4 development — controllers, models, routing, database, security, file uploads, email, caching, testing, authentication, and deployment

plugins.name: codeigniter-skills
plugins.description: Comprehensive CodeIgniter skill covering CI3 (3.1.x) and CI4 (4.7.x): version-aware controllers, models with mass assignment protection, query builder with transactions, routing, filters/middleware, migrations, file uploads, email, caching, services/DI, events, view layouts, View Cells, Spark CLI, PHPUnit testing, Shield authentication, content negotiation, server config, and production deployment. Includes 30+ CI3-to-CI4 migration mappings and a 13-item security checklist.
